description: Source code implementing the decoding of LSP parameters for AMR speech codec, including functions D_plsf_3 and Init_D_plsf_3, with detailed comments and references to 3GPP standards.

methods.name: D_plsf_3
methods.description: Decodes LSP parameters from quantization indices, handling bad frames and normal frames, updating state and converting LSFs to LSP domain.

methods.name: Init_D_plsf_3
methods.description: Initializes the D_plsfState structure with past RQ values based on provided index.
